jobs.title: Portfolio Manager
jobs.description:
Real Estate Portfolio Manager – Sales & Client Relations

Company: PSR Homes Real Estate L.L.C.

Location: Dubai, UAE

Job Type: Full-Time

Industry: Real Estate

Job Overview

PSR Homes Real Estate L.L.C. is looking for ambitious, energetic and client-focused professionals to join our growing team in Dubai as a Real Estate Portfolio Manager.

The role focuses on managing existing client portfolios, building strong investor relationships, generating new business opportunities and providing end-to-end real estate investment solutions.

We offer an exciting opportunity to work in Dubai’s dynamic property market with an attractive commission structure and excellent earning potential.

Key Responsibilities

\* Manage and maintain a portfolio of existing real estate investors and clients.

\* Build long-term relationships through regular communication and professional client servicing.

\* Understand clients’ investment objectives, budgets and property requirements.

\* Recommend suitable Dubai real estate investment opportunities.

\* Manage client portfolios and provide updates on rental yields, ROI and capital appreciation.

\* Generate new sales through existing client relationships, referrals and business development.

\* Handle property presentations, negotiations and successful sales closures.

\* Identify upselling, cross-selling and reinvestment opportunities.

\* Coordinate with developers and internal teams to ensure excellent client experience.

\* Maintain client information, follow-ups and activities through CRM.

\* Achieve monthly sales targets and contribute to business growth.

Requirements

\* 2–5 years of experience in Dubai real estate sales or client relationship management preferred.

\* Strong communication and negotiation skills.

\* Excellent client handling and relationship management abilities.

\* Good knowledge of Dubai’s real estate market and major developers.

\* Sales-driven, confident and target-oriented personality.

\* Ability to manage multiple client portfolios.

\* UAE real estate experience is an advantage.

What We Offer

\* Attractive commission structure with high earning potential.

\* Competitive salary package.

\* Performance-based incentives and rewards.

\* Opportunity to work with leading Dubai developers.

\* Access to quality investor leads and business opportunities.

\* Career growth and leadership opportunities.

\* Professional and supportive working environment.

Why Join PSR Homes?

Be part of a growing Dubai real estate company where your performance, client relationships and sales achievements are rewarded. Build your career, grow your client portfolio and unlock unlimited earning potential.

Apply Now and become part of the PSR Homes team!

Pay: AED3,500.00 - AED4,500.00 per month

Work Location: In person
